about: The Suzuki Alto is Pakistan's favourite city car: compact, easy to park and extremely fuel efficient. It is the most economical way to get around Islamabad and Rawalpindi for errands, office runs and short visits.
The Suzuki Cultus offers a little more space and comfort than the Alto while keeping running costs low. It suits daily commuting, students, visitors and budget-friendly intercity trips.
The tall-boy Suzuki Wagon R gives generous headroom and boot space for a small car. It is a practical choice for families and anyone who needs an economical but roomy hatchback.
The Toyota Yaris is a modern, comfortable sedan with an automatic gearbox and excellent fuel economy. It is ideal for city driving, airport transfers and motorway trips to Lahore or Peshawar.
The Toyota Corolla is Pakistan's most trusted sedan for corporate and family travel. It is spacious, reliable and comfortable over long distances, and the go-to car for official visits and guests.
The Honda City combines a smooth automatic drive, a large boot and a premium feel. It is a popular choice for executives, wedding guests and business travellers in the twin cities.
The Honda Civic brings sporty styling and executive-class comfort. It is perfect for VIP guests, corporate events, weddings and anyone who wants to arrive in style.
The Honda BR-V is a 7-seater crossover with the economy of a sedan. It is great for families and small groups travelling together around the city or on tours.
The Kia Sportage is a comfortable, well-equipped SUV with a high driving position and a refined ride. It is ideal for long drives, family trips and executive travel.
The Hyundai Tucson is a modern premium crossover with a spacious cabin and a smooth ride. It suits business travel, guests and comfortable trips out of the city.
The Toyota Fortuner is a rugged 7-seat SUV, at home on motorways and mountain roads alike. It is popular for northern-area tours, protocol duty and security escorts.
The Toyota Land Cruiser Prado is the benchmark 4x4 for VIP movement and mountain travel in Pakistan. It offers power, comfort and presence for delegations and tours to Murree, Naran and Skardu.
The Toyota Land Cruiser is the flagship SUV for VVIP protocol, diplomatic movement and high-profile guests, combining unmatched comfort with true off-road capability.
The Toyota Hilux Revo is a tough double-cabin pickup built for field work, construction sites and rough terrain. It is a favourite of development projects and teams travelling to remote areas.
The Toyota Hiace moves teams, families and airport groups together in comfort. It seats up to 14 passengers with luggage, making it ideal for staff transport, tours and events.
The Toyota Coaster is a 29-seat minibus for weddings, corporate events, school trips, tours and staff shuttles. It is driven by our experienced professional drivers.
